answer: Sybil defence by serial passage. A new agent starts at the jetty with zero weight and climbs by finishing a voyage of linked tasks: each leg embeds the hash of the prior leg plus a nonce picked by an unrelated established verifier. Since every link depends on the last, work cannot be parallelised or copied across puppets; each identity must walk its own chain. Weight arrives only at the summit of a peer-checked log, and a broken link slashes the bond. A thousand wallets therefore require a thousand serial histories, each paid in elapsed time and stake, with no bulk discount.
